<h1>Watercolour washes</h1>
<p class="sg-lede">Loose watercolour and ink washes: a red bloom, green and blue ink washes, blue flowers, a blue ring, a figure in red and in blue, red blooms, a green flower and a blue handprint. The paint is translucent, so each wash takes the colour of its ground. PNG only, long side up to 1000px.</p>
<dl class="sg-facts"><dt>Use for</dt><dd>A soft patch of colour behind a title, a quote or a portrait.</dd><dt>Colour</dt><dd>As painted, translucent: each wash takes the colour of its ground. Never retint them.</dd><dt>Grounds</dt><dd>White, Paper, Sunlight</dd><dt>Registers</dt><dd>Conversation, Gathering</dd><dt>Formats</dt><dd>PNG</dd><dt>Rights</dt><dd>Not cleared. Traced or cut from mood board images whose rights are not cleared: fine for mockups and drafts; redraw, re-source or clear before anything goes public.</dd></dl>
<p class="sg-note">On night the washes mostly disappear, so keep them to light grounds.</p>
</header>
